_doc: Catalogue identity ledger: hand decisions about duplicates. Read by tools/build_data.py (apply_identity) and tools/audit_duplicates.py. merges: old id -> surviving id (redirected everywhere). distinct: pairs checked and kept apart; 'pending': true means the owner still has to decide. sale_overrides: exclude (kept for the record, never priced) or reassign a single sale.
